turns.text: 9:50 pm update. can you make me a printable nap-and-feed chart for the fridge, plus a simple label image for the fridge bins? muted colors please, sage/gray/cream, nothing neon. the chart needs to match what the shared baby-tracker app shows so my wife and my mom can use either the app or the paper, same categories in the same order. i'm also keeping a weekly summary tab in my old spreadsheet so it'd be nice if the chart rows line up with that

Happy to. Since the chart needs to mirror the app, can you tell me which categories the app uses and in what order? If you don't have them handy, I'll use a standard set and you can swap the names. Here's my plan:

[Image: a portrait letter-size chart on a cream background with a sage-green header reading "Nap & Feed Log". The grid has one row per entry, with columns for Time, Type (Feed / Nap / Diaper), Amount or Duration, and Notes. A weekly totals strip sits at the bottom, laid out to line up with a spreadsheet summary tab. The palette is sage, warm gray and cream, with thin gray lines.]

[Image: a set of three rounded rectangle fridge-bin labels in cream with sage-green text and a thin gray border, with blank lines for handwriting.]

Tell me the app's category order and I'll rework the columns to match.

ok good start. app order is feeds, naps, diapers, then notes. the chart is going in the crib corner, the nursery half of our spare room, so it'll hang by the white noise machine (it's on rain, don't ask). it needs two extra columns: room temperature and mood. i'd also like a mood scale, like 1-5, so we can look for patterns. maybe also a column for what he did in the hour before a nap? basically i want to be able to figure out what predicts a good nap

Great, here's the revised version, with sections in the app's order:

[Image: a revised cream-colored letter-size chart with a sage header, "Nap & Feed Log". The sections run in the same order as the app: Feeds, Naps, Diapers, Notes. The columns are Time, Amount/Duration, Room Temp (°F), Mood (1-5), and Before Nap (what happened in the prior hour). A small legend at the top shows the mood scale: 1 = very fussy, 3 = neutral, 5 = calm and happy. The bottom has a weekly summary strip with rows that match a spreadsheet tab. A small rain-cloud icon in the corner reads "white noise: rain" in muted gray.]

[Image: a trio of bin labels in the same palette: "Feeds", "Naps", and "Diapers", each with a small line icon in sage, plus a blank fourth label for extras.]

Since the chart will hang in the nursery by the crib, I made the text large enough to read in dim light. For the Before Nap column, short codes like "walk", "feed" or "play" keep the entries quick. Want an A4 version or a version with larger rows for night use?
larger rows for night use would be great, thanks. typing one-handed so sorry for typos

No apology needed.

[Image: a night-use version of the chart with the same cream, sage and gray palette, but with taller rows, bolder gray lines and larger type. Columns are Time, Amount/Duration, Room Temp, Mood (1-5) and Notes, and the mood legend sits at the top. A faint sage band highlights the overnight rows so they're easy to find with sleepy eyes.]

Tip: print it on matte paper to cut glare, and clip a pen on a string next to it. If you'd like, I can make a one-page weekly summary sheet too, so it's easy to copy totals into your spreadsheet.
